policy_title: Crack Down on Organised Waste Crime and Fly Tipping
stated: The Conservative Party will take comprehensive action to crack down on organised waste crime, especially those impacting protected nature sites, and deliver enhanced penalties for fly tipping.

source.quote: We will take comprehensive action to crack down on organised waste crime, especially those who impact protected nature sites. We will deliver our enhanced penalties for fly tipping, giving councils new tools to help tackle offenders.

bearing_set.reason: Enhanced penalties and enforcement against organised waste crime and fly-tipping directly bear on the crime/justice system and community safety indicators.
Waste crime and fly-tipping on protected nature sites directly impacts water quality, air quality, and natural environment — a real verdict on clean environment is warranted.

membership_note: Two genuine bearings: O5 (the criminal-enforcement side) and O6 (the environmental/nature-protection side). No specific coercive surveillance or search powers are described, so O10 cannot be pinned to a concrete mechanism and indicator. Fiscal or prosperity effects are too indirect and unquantified to clear the non-negligible bar.
